content.q: What is the concentration of Vitamin C in GlowBoost Serum?
content.a: GlowBoost Vitamin C Serum features a professional-grade 10% Vitamin C concentration, balanced for effectiveness and skin tolerance.

content.q: How should I incorporate this into my morning routine?
content.a: Apply 2–3 drops in the morning on cleansed skin. It is crucial to follow up with sunscreen as Vitamin C works best when protected from UV exposure.

content.q: Is this serum suitable for oily skin types?
content.a: Yes, GlowBoost is specifically formulated for Oily and Combination skin types, providing hydration without a greasy finish.

content.q: What are the common side effects of using this 10% serum?
content.a: Users with sensitive skin may experience mild tingling. This is a common reaction to active Vitamin C and typically subsides with regular use.

content.q: Can I use this serum alongside Hyaluronic Acid?
content.a: GlowBoost already contains Hyaluronic Acid as a key ingredient, ensuring your skin stays hydrated while the Vitamin C works on brightening.
